caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned centrally against a light beige background. The pitcher has a tall cylindrical body and a single handle. The upper portion, including the scalloped rim and spout, is rendered in a deep red color. Below the red section, there is a decorative band with triangular patterns. The main body of the pitcher consists of vertical, fluted, transparent segments with shades of green, blue, and slight touches of red, giving a faceted, jewel-like appearance. The handle, attached near the top and curving downward, reflects similar colors as the main body. The base of the pitcher is circular and also decorated with repeating diamond and square shapes in muted greens and reds. The background around the pitcher is blank, but there is a white irregular shape immediately behind and beneath the pitcher, likely representing a surface or shadow.
title: Souvenir Pitcher
